verdict.rationale: Tavily ships a first-party hosted MCP server (mcp.tavily.com) that exposes search, extract, crawl, map and research as ready-made tools for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, VS Code or any MCP client. It also offers Agent Skills that are installed with the CLI and a one-step agent setup, so the core of plugging it into an agent as a tool is clearly delivered. missing for 10: explicit published function-calling/tool JSON schemas (the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every path), documented agent-framework integrations such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, independent hands-on corroboration of tool-call use.
